plugins.name: ai-look-up
plugins.description: Catches aimless AI grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and nudges the agent to stop and self-review mid-run. Also injects the real local time on a schedule, since agents are bad at judging how long they've been going. v0.7 adds an out-of-host review channel: the hook writes a request, and an independent watcher process (with its own API key) reviews asynchronously and sends back a verdict. The main agent never touches this path. v0.9 adds round milestones: every N turns or every N tool calls, it force-injects a global re-plan prompt regardless of behavior, against local-optimum grinding. v0.10 closes the lesson loop (editing after a failure downgrades the block to a warning, a successful run redeems the pitfall), catches sandwiched failure loops (fail -> read -> fail -> read -> fail), keeps the original goal across short "continue" replies, and flags repeated Grep / ranged-Read calls.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 盯住 AI 的空跑:重复的命令、连续失败、跑很久却没产出文件。命中就在运行中途提醒它停一下自查,并定期把真实本地时间注进去——AI 估不准自己花了多久。v0.7 加了第三通道:钩子只写一张请求单,宿主外面一个独立 watcher(用自己的 key)异步审查再回注结论,主代理全程碰不到这条链路。带 /lookup-review、/lookup-status、/lookup-config、/lookup-watch 四个命令。v0.9 加了轮次里程碑:连续 N 个回合或每 N 步调用,不看行为好坏强制注入一次全局重规划提醒,专治钻牛角尖陷入局部最优。v0.10 让教训账本闭环:改过代码即解锁拦截、跑通即消坑;识别夹在只读调用之间的同命令连败;短回复不再冲掉最初任务;重复的 Grep 与带行号范围的 Read 也会判空转。
